sourceAuthority: Wikimedia Commons exact File pages and matching museum inventories, for license validation and real byte/pixel download in CI
rules: WORK_VARIANT_HOLD images show real art but cannot automatically inherit October 12 approval; retain original identity choice and make the uncertainty explicit.
Only complete original painting photographs accepted; never replace photos with crops, artist-wide topic matches, digital drawings, derivative study or school variant.
Acquired source licensing and SHA do not certify final app publication rights.
Do not show final curator HTML until visual images render and records are attributed to correct works.
